shared_elements: coarse stone surface worked by carving
simplified schematic body parts rendered in low relief (limbs/arms indicated on the block face)
roughly rectangular block silhouette with a distinct upper zone
justification: Both are monumental stone blocks whose surfaces carry schematic, shallowly modelled body parts on a broadly rectangular vertical field, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A is a flat slab covered with stacked registers of small animal and figure reliefs, while B is a single fully three-dimensional human figure with volumetric head and torso and almost no surface ornament, so arrangement and manner of carving differ fundamentally.
